## L4 · Digest + Speed-to-Lead board
**Board:** open `/webhook/halden-board` in a browser. Last 7 days from HubSpot: median seconds from form submit to first email, tiers, reply rate, newest leads. Refreshes every minute.
**Digest:** every day at **8 AM PKT**, the same numbers for the last 24 hours plus the hot-lead list, emailed to the team.

One path for both: the trigger decides the mode.

## Numbers come from HubSpot only
4 searches: recent leads (newest 100) + totals for awaiting / replied / closed.
All lead text is HTML-escaped before it reaches the page or email.
The board is read-only. Before putting n8n on the public internet, add Basic Auth to the webhook.
